title: Harness definitions (P11 first values, S8)
note: Reviewed mapping harness_id -> pinned image digest, launch command, mounts, model/effort catalogue and bootstrap authority. Nothing here is request-suppliable (ADR 0006). imageDigest stays a placeholder until CI's image build publishes the real one (no Docker in the environment this was authored in — see harnesses/claude-code/README.md). The model list is a REVIEWED, curated subset of what the adapter actually offers (measured live, harnesses/claude-code/README.md) — 'default' is deliberately excluded: it is an alias for whatever the account's current default happens to be, not a stable per-model identity Intent authoring can pin to. Revisit whenever the account's model roster changes; a model retired upstream must be removed here before an Intent can be authored against it again.
